## WHERE THIS SERVICE ANSWERS: Local bind and public DNS URL. public_ip is a legacy key name; set it to the HTTPS configuration service URL.
## THE CHAIN NODES: Every validator a caller may use, best first, comma separated. It publishes the whole list, so a Data Owner whose first node is down tries the next. /health asks all of them and says how many answered. One node or six.
## WHAT THE DEPLOY LEFT: One file, written by the deploy as its last step: the addresses and every contract ABI this service hands out. Empty means the file beside this one. It is re-read on its own when a new deploy replaces it; nothing needs restarting.
## THE OTHER SERVICES: Public DNS URLs only. Legacy operator IP fields are localhost placeholders and are never published.
## WHICH APPS THIS NETWORK NEEDS: The oldest application version each product needs here, as do=0.3.0,req=0.3.0. Empty means no minimum. Older apps keep their saved settings and tell their user to update first.
